transaction_cost.note: Entry commission is booked immediately as negative balance/gross loss. Positive exit deals contribute price P/L minus exit commission to gross profit; non-positive exit deals plus their exit commission contribute to gross loss.

state_machine_order: broker protective stop processing at current executable quote
new-minute reset and virtual bracket freeze
if position open: mark as observed, then max-hold, then trailing, then return
if previously observed position disappeared: opposite-side same-minute rearm, then return
otherwise evaluate one fresh virtual-bracket entry

position_observation_latch.description: A newly entered position must survive to a later OnTick and be observed open before its later disappearance can trigger REARM. An entry that is stopped before the next OnTick is not rearmed.

price_normalization.tick_normalization_equation: MathRound(price / 0.01) * 0.01 equivalent for positive XAUUSD prices
price_normalization.integer_equivalent_for_raw_quotes: nearest Coinexx tick with half-up ties
price_normalization.minute_cycle_threshold_validation: 1366/1366 BUY and 1366/1366 SELL January-2 minute starts exact
